sections.title: When Level Correlations Weaken in Annual Changes: Seven Accepted InsightForge Comparisons

statements.text: This BriefForge presentation organizes accepted InsightForge T-039 findings without recomputing, reassessing, or changing their analytical authority.

Seven selected WDI relationships show one recurring warning: level correlations weaken materially in same-year annual changes. Every explicitly included relationship has a smaller absolute first-difference coefficient than raw coefficient and was published with the qualitative classification weakens materially.

T031-DNK-private-credit-broad-money — Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP) versus broad money (% of GDP); raw Pearson 0.316082156476 (raw, 1990-2024, n=35); first-difference Pearson -0.083567273412 (first_difference, 1991-2024, n=34); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: core governed inquiry. The accepted positive level association does not persist as comparable same-period annual-change co-movement; the cause of attenuation is not identified.

T033-NOR-fossil-nonhydro-renewables — Electricity production from fossil sources (% of total) versus non-hydro renewable sources (% of total); raw Pearson 0.315942832953 (raw, 1990-2021, n=32); first-difference Pearson -0.204185174675 (first_difference, 1991-2021, n=31); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: core governed inquiry. The positive level association is not preserved as positive annual-change co-movement, but sign change does not establish reversal or substitution.

T035-C1-NOR-life-expectancy-under5-mortality — Life expectancy at birth versus under-5 mortality; raw Pearson -0.951151571489 (raw, 1990-2024, n=35); first-difference Pearson -0.207863151096 (first_difference, 1991-2024, n=34); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: context-only relationship. The very strong negative level coefficient is much smaller in annual changes; the published evidence does not identify whether trend, measurement, noise, or omitted factors explain the attenuation.

T035-C1-NOR-nonhydro-renewables-under5-mortality — Non-hydro renewable electricity share versus under-5 mortality; raw Pearson -0.652623909096 (raw, 1990-2021, n=32); first-difference Pearson 0.3855860099 (first_difference, 1991-2021, n=31); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: context-only relationship. The coefficient changes sign across level and annual-change estimands; this weakens the raw interpretation but does not establish reversal or an energy-to-mortality mechanism.

T035-C1-NOR-fossil-under5-mortality — Fossil electricity share versus under-5 mortality; raw Pearson -0.618717118858 (raw, 1990-2023, n=34); first-difference Pearson -0.083376899169 (first_difference, 1991-2023, n=33); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: context-only relationship. The negative level coefficient becomes numerically much smaller in annual changes; this does not establish absence, independence, or a mortality mechanism.

T036-SWE-private-credit-mobile-subscriptions — Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP) versus mobile cellular subscriptions (per 100 people); raw Pearson 0.937758474347 (raw, 1990-2024, n=35); first-difference Pearson 0.161115218727 (first_difference, 1991-2024, n=34); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: qualified analytical byproduct. The very strong positive level coefficient is not preserved as comparably strong annual-change co-movement; T-036 retains this analytical byproduct while remaining checkpoint-nonconforming.

T038-DNK-agricultural-land-private-credit — Agricultural land (% of land area) versus domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP); raw Pearson -0.667417505516 (raw, 1990-2023, n=34); first-difference Pearson 0.058190335423 (first_difference, 1991-2023, n=33); classification: weakens materially; evidence role: core governed inquiry. The negative level coefficient is not preserved as comparable annual-change co-movement; sign change does not establish reversal, and strict compliance applies only to this inherited-selection inquiry.

The rows are small, selected, nonrandom, and dependent. T-035 does not enlarge the core governed sample; T-036 remains qualified; T-038 uses inherited selection. Raw and first-difference coefficients answer different estimands: same-period co-movement in levels versus same-period co-movement in annual changes. Attenuation is a transformation-aware reassessment, not a corrected estimate of the same quantity. The admitted frontier has raw and first-difference Pearson evidence only; no significance, stationarity, rolling, lagged, rank, regression, partial-correlation, subperiod, break, regime, or robustness family is admitted.
